statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // "Claude"'); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd // ""'); dir=$(basename "$cwd"); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); ctx=""; [ -n "$used" ] && ctx=" | ctx: $(printf '%.0f' "$used")%"; printf "%s | %s%s" "$model" "$dir" "$ctx"

hooks.prompt: Check if the Bash command in $ARGUMENTS was a 'git push'. If it was, and it succeeded, find the open PR number for the current branch in litlfred/qou using mcp__github__list_pull_requests, then subscribe to PR activity using mcp__github__subscribe_pr_activity so CI failures and review comments are delivered to the session. If the command was not a git push, or there is no open PR, do nothing.
